```{r, include=FALSE}
library(adegenet)
library(vcfR)

library("dplyr")
library("ggplot2") #For plotting
library("reshape2") #For plotting
library(pantomime)
library(tibble)
library(poppr)
library(psych)
library(adespatial)
library(vegan)

theme_black = function(base_size = 16, base_family = "") {
  
  theme_grey(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) %+replace%
    
    theme(
      # Specify axis options
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "white", size = 1.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = base_size*0.8, color = "white", lineheight = 0.9),  
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = base_size*0.8, color = "white", lineheight = 0.9),  
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "white", size  =  0.2),  
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = base_size, color = "white", margin = margin(0, 10, 0, 0)),  
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = base_size, color = "white", angle = 90, margin = margin(0, 10, 0, 0)),  
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.3, "lines"),   
      # Specify legend options
      legend.background = element_rect(color = NA, fill = "transparent"),  
      legend.key = element_rect(color = NA,  fill = "transparent"),  
      legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines"),  
      legend.key.height = NULL,  
      legend.key.width = NULL,      
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size*0.8, color = "white"),  
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size*0.8, face = "bold", hjust = 0, color = "white"),  
      legend.position = "right",  
      legend.text.align = NULL,  
      legend.title.align = NULL,  
      legend.direction = "vertical",  
      legend.box = NULL, 
      # Specify panel options
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color  =  NA),  
      panel.border = element_blank(),  
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "transparent"),  
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "transparent"),  
      #panel.margin = unit(0.5, "lines"),   
      panel.spacing= unit(0.5, "lines"),
      # Specify facetting options
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = "transparent"),  
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = base_size*0.8, color = "white"),  
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = base_size*0.8, color = "white",angle = -90),  
      # Specify plot options
      plot.background = element_rect(color = "transparent", fill = "transparent"),  
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size*1.2, color = "white", hjust = 1),  
      plot.margin = unit(rep(1, 4), "lines")
      
    )
  
}
```

## Making files

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Setting up strata file - population info and environmental data 
strata6 <- read.table("./strata6_red_12var", header=TRUE)

# Making new version of strata file with one row per population
strata_6pops <- strata6 %>% distinct(Population, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
#Providing population names for plotting
pop_order_6pops <- c("BAR","BIS","GB","KIC","MCD","PVD")
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning= FALSE, echo = FALSE}
# Filtered VCF file with the 66 CASE SNPs  
my_vcf_casefilt_CASE <- read.vcfR("CASE_ins.recode.vcf")
my_vcf_casefilt_CAI <- read.vcfR("CA_ins.recode.vcf")
my_vcf_casefilt_SEI <- read.vcfR("SE_ins.recode.vcf")
my_vcf_casefilt_SECASE <- read.vcfR("SE.CASE_ins.recode.vcf")
my_vcf_casefilt <- read.vcfR("CASE_SNPs.recode.vcf")
my_vcf_casefilt_I <- read.vcfR("CASE_SNPs_intervals.recode.vcf")

my_vcf_casefilt_SE.FACTOR <- read.vcfR("SE.FACTOR_ins.recode.vcf")
my_vcf_casefilt_CA.FACTOR <- read.vcfR("CA.FACTOR_ins.recode.vcf")
my_vcf_casefilt_CA.ONLY <- read.vcfR("CA.ONLY_ins.recode.vcf")
my_vcf_casefilt_CASE.ONLY <- read.vcfR("CASE.ONLY_ins.recode.vcf")
my_vcf_casefilt_SE.ONLY <- read.vcfR("SE.ONLY_ins.recode.vcf")
my_vcf_casefilt_CA.CASE_I <- read.vcfR("CA.CASE_ins.recode.vcf")
my_vcf_casefilt_SE.CA_I <- read.vcfR("SE.CA_ins.recode.vcf")
my_vcf_casefilt_SE.CASE.CA_I <- read.vcfR("SE.CASE.CA_ins.recode.vcf")


rad_casefilt.filt_CASE <- vcfR2genind(my_vcf_casefilt_CASE, strata = strata6, pop = c(rep("BAR", 10),rep("BIS", 10),rep("GB", 10),rep("KIC", 10),rep("MCD", 10), rep("PVD",10)))
rad_casefilt.filt_SEI <- vcfR2genind(my_vcf_casefilt_SEI, strata = strata6, pop = c(rep("BAR", 10),rep("BIS", 10),rep("GB", 10),rep("KIC", 10),rep("MCD", 10), rep("PVD",10)))
rad_casefilt.filt_CAI <- vcfR2genind(my_vcf_casefilt_CAI, strata = strata6, pop = c(rep("BAR", 10),rep("BIS", 10),rep("GB", 10),rep("KIC", 10),rep("MCD", 10), rep("PVD",10)))
rad_casefilt.filt_SECASE <- vcfR2genind(my_vcf_casefilt_SECASE, strata = strata6, pop = c(rep("BAR", 10),rep("BIS", 10),rep("GB", 10),rep("KIC", 10),rep("MCD", 10), rep("PVD",10)))
rad_casefilt.filt <- vcfR2genind(my_vcf_casefilt, strata = strata6, pop = c(rep("BAR", 10),rep("BIS", 10),rep("GB", 10),rep("KIC", 10),rep("MCD", 10), rep("PVD",10)))
rad_casefilt.filt_I <- vcfR2genind(my_vcf_casefilt_I, strata = strata6, pop = c(rep("BAR", 10),rep("BIS", 10),rep("GB", 10),rep("KIC", 10),rep("MCD", 10), rep("PVD",10)))

rad_casefilt.filt_SE.FACTOR <- vcfR2genind(my_vcf_casefilt_SE.FACTOR, strata = strata6, pop = c(rep("BAR", 10),rep("BIS", 10),rep("GB", 10),rep("KIC", 10),rep("MCD", 10), rep("PVD",10)))
rad_casefilt.filt_CA.FACTOR <- vcfR2genind(my_vcf_casefilt_CA.FACTOR, strata = strata6, pop = c(rep("BAR", 10),rep("BIS", 10),rep("GB", 10),rep("KIC", 10),rep("MCD", 10), rep("PVD",10)))
rad_casefilt.filt_CA.ONLY <- vcfR2genind(my_vcf_casefilt_CA.ONLY, strata = strata6, pop = c(rep("BAR", 10),rep("BIS", 10),rep("GB", 10),rep("KIC", 10),rep("MCD", 10), rep("PVD",10)))
rad_casefilt.filt_CASE.ONLY <- vcfR2genind(my_vcf_casefilt_CASE.ONLY, strata = strata6, pop = c(rep("BAR", 10),rep("BIS", 10),rep("GB", 10),rep("KIC", 10),rep("MCD", 10), rep("PVD",10)))
rad_casefilt.filt_SE.ONLY <- vcfR2genind(my_vcf_casefilt_SE.ONLY, strata = strata6, pop = c(rep("BAR", 10),rep("BIS", 10),rep("GB", 10),rep("KIC", 10),rep("MCD", 10), rep("PVD",10)))
rad_casefilt.filt_CA.CASE <- vcfR2genind(my_vcf_casefilt_CA.CASE_I, strata = strata6, pop = c(rep("BAR", 10),rep("BIS", 10),rep("GB", 10),rep("KIC", 10),rep("MCD", 10), rep("PVD",10)))
rad_casefilt.filt_SE.CA <- vcfR2genind(my_vcf_casefilt_SE.CA_I, strata = strata6, pop = c(rep("BAR", 10),rep("BIS", 10),rep("GB", 10),rep("KIC", 10),rep("MCD", 10), rep("PVD",10)))
```

## Seascape Redundancy Analysis 

### Prep Environmental Data

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Import environmental data
env.raw = strata_6pops[,3:17]
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Import spatial data
dbmem.raw = read.csv("../RDAV2/dbmems_6pops.csv")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Removing latitude and longitude
env.data = subset(env.raw, select = -c(Latitude,Longitude,SewageEffluent))
# pairs.panels(env.full_out6, scale = TRUE)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
#standardize the environmental data 
# Scale and center variables
env.z <- decostand(env.data, method = "standardize")
# Variables are now centered around a mean of 0
round(apply(env.z, 2, mean), 1)
# and scaled to have a standard deviation of 1
apply(env.z, 2, sd)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
#combine env and dbmem datasets 
env.full = cbind(env.z, dbmem.raw)
str(env.full)
```

### Prep allele frequency data

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Calculate allele frequencies for each site
allele_freqs_casefilt_CASE = data.frame(rraf(rad_casefilt.filt_CASE, by_pop = TRUE, correction = FALSE), check.names = FALSE)
allele_freqs_casefilt_SEI = data.frame(rraf(rad_casefilt.filt_SEI, by_pop = TRUE, correction = FALSE), check.names = FALSE)
allele_freqs_casefilt_CAI = data.frame(rraf(rad_casefilt.filt_CAI, by_pop = TRUE, correction = FALSE), check.names = FALSE)

allele_freqs_casefilt_CA.FACTOR = data.frame(rraf(rad_casefilt.filt_CA.FACTOR, by_pop = TRUE, correction = FALSE), check.names = FALSE)

allele_freqs_casefilt_SE.ONLY = data.frame(rraf(rad_casefilt.filt_SE.ONLY, by_pop = TRUE, correction = FALSE), check.names = FALSE)

# Keep only the first of the two alleles for each SNP (since p=1-q).

allele_freqs_casefilt_I = allele_freqs_casefilt_I[, seq(1, dim(allele_freqs_casefilt_I)[2], 2)]

allele_freqs_casefilt_SE.FACTOR = allele_freqs_casefilt_SE.FACTOR[, seq(1, dim(allele_freqs_casefilt_SE.FACTOR)[2], 2)]
allele_freqs_casefilt_CA.FACTOR = allele_freqs_casefilt_CA.FACTOR[, seq(1, dim(allele_freqs_casefilt_CA.FACTOR)[2], 2)]
```

**Minor allele frequencies**

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Separate genind object by site
site_list_casefilt_CASE = seppop(rad_casefilt.filt_CASE)
site_list_casefilt_SEI = seppop(rad_casefilt.filt_SEI)
site_list_casefilt_SECASE = seppop(rad_casefilt.filt_SECASE)
site_list_casefilt = seppop(rad_casefilt.filt)
site_list_casefilt_I = seppop(rad_casefilt.filt_I)

# Convert list to dataframe
maf_casefilt_CASE = as.data.frame(lapply(site_list_casefilt_CASE, FUN = minorAllele)) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
maf_casefilt_SEI = as.data.frame(lapply(site_list_casefilt_SEI, FUN = minorAllele)) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
maf_casefilt_SECASE = as.data.frame(lapply(site_list_casefilt_SECASE, FUN = minorAllele)) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
maf_casefilt = as.data.frame(lapply(site_list_casefilt, FUN = minorAllele)) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
maf_casefilt_I = as.data.frame(lapply(site_list_casefilt_I, FUN = minorAllele)) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
```

### Identify significant environmental predictors in RDA model

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Set seed
set.seed(123)
```

```{r, include =FALSE}
# Use forward selection to identify significant environmental variables with ordiR2step
# first we need to create a null model and then a full model 
## Null model
RDA0_casefilt_CASE <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_CASE ~ 1,  env.full) 
RDA0_casefilt_SEI <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_SEI ~ 1,  env.full) 
RDA0_casefilt_CAI <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_CAI ~ 1,  env.full) 
RDA0_casefilt_SECASE <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_SECASE ~ 1,  env.full) 
RDA0_casefilt <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt ~ 1,  env.full) 
RDA0_casefilt_I <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_I ~ 1,  env.full) 

RDA0_casefilt_SE.FACTOR <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_SE.FACTOR ~ 1,  env.full) 
RDA0_casefilt_CA.FACTOR <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_CA.FACTOR ~ 1,  env.full) 
RDA0_casefilt_CA.ONLY <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_CA.ONLY ~ 1,  env.full) 
RDA0_casefilt_CASE.ONLY <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_CASE.ONLY ~ 1,  env.full) 
RDA0_casefilt_SE.ONLY <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_SE.ONLY ~ 1,  env.full) 
RDA0_casefilt_CA.CASE <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_CA.CASE ~ 1,  env.full) 
RDA0_casefilt_SE.CA <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_SE.CA ~ 1,  env.full) 
RDA0_casefilt_SE.CASE.CA <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_SE.CASE.CA ~ 1,  env.full) 


## full model
RDA_casefilt_CASE <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_CASE ~ ., env.full)
RDA_casefilt_SEI <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_SEI  ~ ., env.full)
RDA_casefilt_CAI <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_CAI  ~ ., env.full)
RDA_casefilt_SECASE <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_SECASE ~ ., env.full)
RDA_casefilt <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt ~ ., env.full)
RDA_casefilt_I <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_I ~ ., env.full)
RDA_casefilt_SE.FACTOR <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_SE.FACTOR ~ .,  env.full) 
RDA_casefilt_CA.FACTOR <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_CA.FACTOR ~ .,  env.full) 
RDA_casefilt_CA.ONLY <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_CA.ONLY ~ .,  env.full) 
RDA_casefilt_CASE.ONLY <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_CASE.ONLY ~ .,  env.full) 
RDA_casefilt_SE.ONLY <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_SE.ONLY ~ .,  env.full) 
RDA_casefilt_CA.CASE <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_CA.CASE ~ .,  env.full) 
RDA_casefilt_SE.CA <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_SE.CA ~ .,  env.full) 
RDA_casefilt_SE.CASE.CA <- rda(allele_freqs_casefilt_SE.CASE.CA ~ .,  env.full) 

## adjusted R squared of full. model
adjR2.RDA_casefilt_CASE <- RsquareAdj(RDA_casefilt_CASE)$adj.r.squared
adjR2.RDA_casefilt_SEI <- RsquareAdj(RDA_casefilt_SEI)$adj.r.squared
adjR2.RDA_casefilt_CAI <- RsquareAdj(RDA_casefilt_CAI)$adj.r.squared
adjR2.RDA_casefilt_SECASE <- RsquareAdj(RDA_casefilt_SECASE)$adj.r.squared
adjR2.RDA_casefilt <- RsquareAdj(RDA_casefilt)$adj.r.squared
adjR2.RDA_casefilt_I <- RsquareAdj(RDA_casefilt_I)$adj.r.squared

adjR2.RDA_casefilt_SE.FACTOR <- RsquareAdj(RDA_casefilt_SE.FACTOR)$adj.r.squared
adjR2.RDA_casefilt_CA.FACTOR <- RsquareAdj(RDA_casefilt_CA.FACTOR)$adj.r.squared
adjR2.RDA_casefilt_CA.ONLY <- RsquareAdj(RDA_casefilt_CA.ONLY)$adj.r.squared
adjR2.RDA_casefilt_CASE.ONLY <- RsquareAdj(RDA_casefilt_CASE.ONLY)$adj.r.squared
adjR2.RDA_casefilt_SE.ONLY <- RsquareAdj(RDA_casefilt_SE.ONLY)$adj.r.squared
adjR2.RDA_casefilt_CA.CASE <- RsquareAdj(RDA_casefilt_CA.CASE)$adj.r.squared
adjR2.RDA_casefilt_SE.CA <- RsquareAdj(RDA_casefilt_SE.CA)$adj.r.squared
adjR2.RDA_casefilt_SE.CASE.CA <- RsquareAdj(RDA_casefilt_SE.CASE.CA)$adj.r.squared
```

### Running the Redundancy analysis

**Prepping for plotting** 

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Create a data frame to correctly color regions
# Row names are the same across all allele frequency data sets  
col_dframe = data.frame("site" = c("BAR","BIS","GB","KIC","MCD","PVD"))

# Function to add regional labels to dataframe
addregion_6pops = function(x){
  # If pop label is present function will output the region
  if(x=="BAR") y = " Barrington "
  if(x=="BIS") y = " Bissel Cove "
  if(x=="GB") y = " Greenwich Bay "
  if(x=="KIC") y = " Kickemuit "
  if(x=="MCD") y = " Donovan Marsh "
  if(x=="PVD") y = " Providence "
  return(y)
}

# Add regional labels
col_dframe$region = sapply(col_dframe$site, addregion_6pops)

# Add factor levels
region_order_6pops = c(" Barrington "," Bissel Cove "," Greenwich Bay "," Kickemuit "," Donovan Marsh ", " Providence ")
col_dframe$region = factor(col_dframe$region, levels = region_order_6pops)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Create color scheme
# green=#7FC97F, blue = #00008B, orange=#FF7F00, purple=#9A32CD, pink=#FF1493, cyan=#00FFFF
cols_6pops = c("#7FC97F","#00008B","#FF7F00","#9A32CD","#FF1493","#00FFFF")
```

**Running RDA and plotting** 
### CASE
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Perform RDA with all significant variables

if (grepl("~ 1", deparse(mod_casefilt_CASE$call))) {
  print("No significant model")
  
  # Construct the formula dynamically
  formula_dynamic <- as.formula(paste("allele_freqs_casefilt ~", env.for_casefilt_CASE$variables[1]))
  
  # Run the rda model with the dynamically created formula
  rda_casefilt <- rda(formula_dynamic, data = env.full, scale = TRUE)
  
} else {
  # Use the model call from mod_casefilt_SEI if it's not a null model
  rda_casefilt <- eval(mod_casefilt_CASE$call)
}

# Model summaries
RsquareAdj(rda_casefilt) # adjusted Rsquared 
anova.cca(rda_casefilt, permutations = 1000) # full model
anova.cca(rda_casefilt, permutations = 1000, by="margin") # per variable 
```

```{r, include =FALSE}
# Variance explained by each canonical axis
summary(eigenvals(rda_casefilt, model = "constrained"))
vif.cca(rda_casefilt) # variance inflation factor (<10 OK)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Visualize results of RDA
#png("rda_casefilt.png", width = 8, height = 7, units = "in", res = 600)
plot(rda_casefilt, type="n", scaling = 3, main= "CASE RDA")
# SITES
points(rda_casefilt, display="sites", pch=21, scaling=3, cex=1.5, col="black",
       bg=cols_6pops[col_dframe$region]) # sites
text(rda_casefilt, display="sites", scaling = 3, col="black", font=2, pos=4)
# PREDICTORS
text(rda_casefilt, display="bp", scaling=3, col="red1", cex=1, lwd=2)
# SNPS
# text(rda_casefilt, display="species", scaling = 3, col="blue", cex=0.7, pos=4) # SNPs
# LEGEND
#legend("bottomright", legend=levels(col_dframe$region), bty="n", col="black",
      #pch=21, cex=1.2, pt.bg=cols_6pops)
# OTHER LABELS
adj.R2 = round(RsquareAdj(rda_casefilt)$adj.r.squared, 3)
mtext(bquote(italic("Adj.R")^"2"~"= "~.(adj.R2)), side = 3, adj = 1)
# dev.off()
```


## Correspondence analysis-based RDA

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Run a CA on the genind object
obj_out_casefilt <- genind2genpop(rad_casefilt.filt_CASE)
ca1_out_casefilt <- dudi.coa(tab(obj_out_casefilt), scannf=FALSE, nf=10)
eig_ca1_out_casefilt <- round((ca1_out_casefilt$eig / (sum(ca1_out_casefilt$eig))) * 100, 2)
out_ca_casefilt <- ca1_out_casefilt$li[,1:2]
rownames(out_ca_casefilt) <- popNames(rad_casefilt.filt_CASE)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
out_ca_casefilt <- out_ca_casefilt %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Population") %>%
  mutate(Population = factor(Population, levels = c("BAR", "BIS", "GB", "KIC", "MCD", "PVD"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(Population, Axis1, Axis2)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
strata_ca_casefilt <- strata_6pops %>%
  left_join(out_ca_casefilt, by = "Population")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Plot the CA
CASE_Sal_COA <- ggplot(strata_ca_casefilt, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, colour = Population)) +
  geom_point(size = 6, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols_6pops,
                      name = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14)) +
  ggtitle("CASE")+
  labs(x = paste("", "Axis 1: ", eig_ca1_out_casefilt[1], "%"), y = paste("", "Axis 2: ", eig_ca1_out_casefilt[2], "%"))

CASE_Sal_COA
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Plot CA1 versus June_Salinity_Avg 

# Assuming `variable_name` is "June_Salinity_Avg"
variable_name <- env.for_casefilt_CASE$variables[1]

# Fit the linear model
sal_mod_casefilt <- lm(as.formula(paste("Axis1 ~", variable_name)), data = strata_ca_casefilt)
model_summary <- summary(sal_mod_casefilt)

# Extract adjusted R2 and p-value
adj_r2 <- signif(model_summary$adj.r.squared, 3)
p_value <- signif(model_summary$coefficients[2,4], 2)

# Use ggplot with the variable name
CASE_Sal_LM <- strata_ca_casefilt %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = Axis1, x = .data[[variable_name]])) +  # Use .data[[variable_name]]
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", col = "darkgrey", lty = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Population), size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_6pops) +
  ggtitle("CASE") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    y = "Average Salinity",
    x = "Axis 1"
  ) +
  annotate("text", 
           x = max(strata_ca_casefilt[[variable_name]]),  # Adjust this value for horizontal gap
           y = max(strata_ca_casefilt$Axis2) + 0.1,  # Adjust this value for vertical gap
           label = paste("Adj R² =", adj_r2, "\np =", p_value),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 1)

CASE_Sal_LM
```

## CA

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Perform RDA with all significant variables

if (grepl("~ 1", deparse(mod_casefilt_CAI$call))) {
  print("No significant model")
  
  # Construct the formula dynamically
  formula_dynamic <- as.formula(paste("allele_freqs_casefilt ~", env.for_casefilt_CAI$variables[1]))
  
  # Run the rda model with the dynamically created formula
  rda_casefilt <- rda(formula_dynamic, data = env.full, scale = TRUE)
  
} else {
  # Use the model call from mod_casefilt_CAI if it's not a null model
  rda_casefilt <- eval(mod_casefilt_CAI$call)
}

# Use the formula in the rda() function
#rda_casefilt <- rda(formula_dynamic, data = env.full, scale = TRUE)
#rda_casefilt <- eval(mod_casefilt_CAI$call)
#rda_casefilt = rda(allele_freqs_casefilt ~ as.text(env.for_casefilt$variables[1]), data = env.full, scale = TRUE)
rda_casefilt

# Model summaries
RsquareAdj(rda_casefilt) # adjusted Rsquared 
vif.cca(rda_casefilt) # variance inflation factor (<10 OK)
anova.cca(rda_casefilt, permutations = 1000) # full model
anova.cca(rda_casefilt, permutations = 1000, by="margin") # per variable 

# Variance explained by each canonical axis
summary(eigenvals(rda_casefilt, model = "constrained"))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
vif.cca(rda_casefilt) # variance inflation factor (<10 OK)
anova.cca(rda_casefilt, permutations = 1000) # full model
anova.cca(rda_casefilt, permutations = 1000, by="margin") # per variable

summary(eigenvals(rda_casefilt, model = "constrained"))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#rda_casefilt = rda(allele_freqs_casefilt ~ as.text(env.for_casefilt$variables[1]), data = env.full, scale = TRUE)
rda_casefilt

# Model summaries
RsquareAdj(rda_casefilt) # adjusted Rsquared 
vif.cca(rda_casefilt) # variance inflation factor (<10 OK)
anova.cca(rda_casefilt, permutations = 1000) # full model
anova.cca(rda_casefilt, permutations = 1000, by="margin") # per variable 

# Variance explained by each canonical axis
summary(eigenvals(rda_casefilt, model = "constrained"))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Visualize results of RDA
#png("rda_casefilt.png", width = 8, height = 7, units = "in", res = 600)
plot(rda_casefilt, type="n", scaling = 3, main ="SE.CA")
# SITES
points(rda_casefilt, display="sites", pch=21, scaling=3, cex=1.5, col="black",
       bg=cols_6pops[col_dframe$region]) # sites
text(rda_casefilt, display="sites", scaling = 3, col="black", font=2, pos=4)
# PREDICTORS
text(rda_casefilt, display="bp", scaling=3, col="red1", cex=1, lwd=2)
# SNPS
# text(rda_casefilt, display="species", scaling = 3, col="blue", cex=0.7, pos=4) # SNPs
# LEGEND
#legend("bottomright", legend=levels(col_dframe$region), bty="n", col="black",
      #pch=21, cex=1.2, pt.bg=cols_6pops)
# OTHER LABELS
adj.R2 = round(RsquareAdj(rda_casefilt)$adj.r.squared, 3)
mtext(bquote(italic("Adj.R")^"2"~"= "~.(adj.R2)), side = 3, adj = 1)
# dev.off()
```


## Correspondence analysis-based RDA
```{r, include=FALSE}
# Run a CA on the genind object
obj_out_casefilt <- genind2genpop(rad_casefilt.filt_SE.CA)
ca1_out_casefilt <- dudi.coa(tab(obj_out_casefilt), scannf=FALSE, nf=10)
eig_ca1_out_casefilt <- round((ca1_out_casefilt$eig / (sum(ca1_out_casefilt$eig))) * 100, 2)
out_ca_casefilt <- ca1_out_casefilt$li[,1:2]
rownames(out_ca_casefilt) <- popNames(rad_casefilt.filt_SE.CA)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
out_ca_casefilt <- out_ca_casefilt %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Population") %>%
  mutate(Population = factor(Population, levels = c("BAR", "BIS", "GB", "KIC", "MCD", "PVD"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(Population, Axis1, Axis2)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
strata_ca_casefilt <- strata_6pops %>%
  left_join(out_ca_casefilt, by = "Population")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Plot the CA
ggplot(strata_ca_casefilt, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, colour = Population)) +
  geom_point(size = 6, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols_6pops,
                      name = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14)) +
  labs(x = paste("", "Axis 1: ", eig_ca1_out_casefilt[1], "%"), y = paste("", "Axis 2: ", eig_ca1_out_casefilt[2], "%"))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}

  geom_smooth(method = "lm", col = "darkgrey", lty = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Population), size = 4) +

  )
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
  ggplot(aes(y = Axis1, x = .data[[variable_name]])) +  # Use .data[[variable_name]]
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
  labs(
    y = "Average Salinity",
    x = "Axis 1"
  ) +
  annotate("text", 
           x = max(strata_ca_casefilt[[variable_name]]),  # Adjust this value for horizontal gap
           y = max(strata_ca_casefilt$Axis2) + 0.1 ,  # Adjust this value for vertical gap

           hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
TOTAL_SAL_LM
```

# Creating BED files from individual treatment VCF files

I decided to make a new working directory and move files there:

In my home directory on KITT

```{bash}
mkdir NB_adultlarval_analysis_V2
cd NB_adultlarval_analysis_V2
```

Linking the VCF files Jon made in `RDAV2` to this new directory:

```{bash}
# CA
ln -s ../RDAV2/CA_ins.recode.vcf . # 118 SNPs
# SE
ln -s ../RDAV2/SE_ins.recode.vcf . # 267 SNPs
# CASE
ln -s ../RDAV2/CASE_ins.recode.vcf . # 563 SNPs
# CA Only
ln -s ../RDAV2/CA.ONLY_ins.recode.vcf . # 89 SNPs
# SE Only
ln -s ../RDAV2/SE.ONLY_ins.recode.vcf . # 170 SNPs
# CASE Only
ln -s ../RDAV2/CASE.ONLY_ins.recode.vcf . # 477 SNPs
# CA & SE Shared
ln -s ../RDAV2/SE.CA_ins.recode.vcf . # 13 SNPs
# CA & CASE Shared
ln -s ../RDAV2/CA.CASE_ins.recode.vcf . # 10 SNPs
# SE & CASE Shared
ln -s ../RDAV2/SE.CASE_ins.recode.vcf . # 77 SNPs
# CA & SE & CASE Shared
```

Extracting the chromosome and SNP position info to a new file and converting it to a BED file

```{bash}
# SE

# SE Only

# CASE Only

# CA & SE Shared
mawk '!/#/' SE.CA_ins.recode.vcf | cut -f1,2 | sort -k1,2 | uniq | mawk '{print $1 "\t" $2-1 "\t" $2}' | bedtools sort -i - > SE.CA.Significant.loci.bed
# CA & CASE Shared

# CA Only + CA & CASE shared (CA Factor)

# SE Only + SE & CASE shared (SE Factor)

# All Candidate
mawk '!/#/' CASE_SNPs.recode.vcf | cut -f1,2 | sort -k1,2 | uniq | mawk '{print $1 "\t" $2-1 "\t" $2}' | bedtools sort -i - > CASE.Total.Significant.loci.bed
# All Candidate Intervals
bedtools slop -b 10 -i <(bedtools sort -i CASE.Total.Significant.loci.bed) -g ../CASE_RDA/from_Jon/reference.fasta.fai  | bedtools merge -i - >  CASE.Total.Significant.loci.intervals.bed
```

**10 outlier loci directly shared, 16 outliers within 10 bps.**


Now, I'm going to break this down by larval treatment and examine any overlapping outlier loci and/or genes between the larval set and adult set. For the Coastal Acidification treatment (CA), I'm going to work with the CA.FACTOR and CA.ONLY datasets, as they were significantly associated with the PC2 variable and salinity, respectively. I will compare these to the adult outlier SNPs that are strongly associated with PC2 (all inversion pcadapt outliers and select LFMM outliers) and salinity (all RDA outliers and select LFMM outliers). For the Sewage Effluent treatment (SE), I'm going to work with the SE.FACTOR and SE.ONLY datasets, as they were significantly associated with salinity and the PC3 variable, respectively. I will compare these to the adult outlier SNPs that are strongly associated with PC3 (all non-inversion pcadapt outliers) and salinity (all RDA outliers and select LFMM outliers). For the combined treatment (CASE), I will be working with the CASE.ONLY dataset which was significantly associated with salinity. I will compare these to the adult outlier SNPs that are strongly associated with salinity (all RDA outliers and select LFMM outliers).

First, prep 10 bp interval bed files for each larval SNP set:

```{r}
png("venn_plots.png", width = 1800, height = 400)  # Extended width for 5 plots

vps <- list(
    viewport(x = 1/10, y = 0.5, width = 0.16, height = 0.9),      # PC2 (CA)
    viewport(x = 3/10, y = 0.5, width = 0.16, height = 0.9),      # Salinity (CA)
    viewport(x = 5/10, y = 0.5, width = 0.16, height = 0.9),      # Salinity (SE)

    viewport(x = 9/10, y = 0.5, width = 0.16, height = 0.9)       # PC3 (SE)
)

# PC2: Adult vs Larval CA
pushViewport(vps[[1]])

venn_pc2 <- draw.pairwise.venn(
    area1 = 24, area2 = 65, cross.area = 1,
    category = c("Adult", "Larval CA"),

    alpha = rep(0.5, 2),
    cat.pos = c(0, -10),
```

```{r}
library(VennDiagram)
library(grid)

png("venn_plots.png", width = 1800, height = 950) # Increased height for 2 rows

# Define larval treatments/colors
larval_treatments <- c("CA", "SE", "CASE")
larval_colors <- c("#EFFD5F", "cadetblue2", "darkolivegreen3")

# Set up 2x3 grid; coordinates are relative to a 2-row grid
grid.newpage()
pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(nrow = 2, ncol = 3, heights = unit(c(0.45, 0.5), "npc"))))

# Helper for positioning
vplayout <- function(row, col) viewport(layout.pos.row = row, layout.pos.col = col)

# Row 1: PC2 and PC3 (centered, left/right empty)
pushViewport(vplayout(1, 1))
grid.text("PC2", y = 0.99, gp = gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"))
venn_pc2 <- draw.pairwise.venn(
  area1 = 24, area2 = 65, cross.area = 1,
  category = c("Adult", "Larval CA"),
  fill = c("grey90", larval_colors[1]),
  alpha = rep(0.5, 2),
  cex = 1.5, cat.cex = 1.3,
  fontfamily = "sans", cat.fontfamily = "sans", cat.fontface = "bold",
  cat.pos = c(0, -10),
  cat.dist = rep(0.025, 2),
  ext.text = FALSE,
  print.mode = "raw"
)
grid.draw(venn_pc2)
popViewport()

pushViewport(vplayout(1, 3))
grid.text("PC3", y = 0.99, gp = gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"))
venn_pc3 <- draw.pairwise.venn(
  area1 = 24, area2 = 121, cross.area = 1,
  category = c("Adult", "Larval SE"),
  fill = c("grey90", larval_colors[2]),
  alpha = rep(0.5, 2),
  cex = 1.5, cat.cex = 1.3,
  fontfamily = "sans", cat.fontfamily = "sans", cat.fontface = "bold",
  cat.pos = c(0, -10),
  cat.dist = rep(0.025, 2),
  ext.text = FALSE,
  print.mode = "raw"
)
grid.draw(venn_pc3)
popViewport()

# Row 2 Salinity diagrams (CA, SE, CASE) with one grouped title above them
pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 2, layout.pos.col = 1:3))
grid.text("Salinity", y = 1, gp = gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"))
popViewport()

pushViewport(vplayout(2, 1))
venn_sal_ca <- draw.pairwise.venn(
  area1 = 233, area2 = 59, cross.area = 10,
  category = c("Adult", "Larval CA"),
  fill = c("grey90", larval_colors[1]),
  alpha = rep(0.5, 2),
  cex = 1.5, cat.cex = 1.3,
  fontfamily = "sans", cat.fontfamily = "sans", cat.fontface = "bold",
  cat.pos = c(0, -10),
  cat.dist = rep(0.025, 2),
  ext.text = FALSE,
  print.mode = "raw"
)
grid.draw(venn_sal_ca)
popViewport()

pushViewport(vplayout(2, 2))
venn_sal_se <- draw.pairwise.venn(
  area1 = 233, area2 = 166, cross.area = 25,
  category = c("Adult", "Larval SE"),
  fill = c("grey90", larval_colors[2]),
  alpha = rep(0.5, 2),
  cex = 1.5, cat.cex = 1.3,
  fontfamily = "sans", cat.fontfamily = "sans", cat.fontface = "bold",
  cat.pos = c(0, -10),
  cat.dist = rep(0.025, 2),
  ext.text = FALSE,
  print.mode = "raw"
)
grid.draw(venn_sal_se)
popViewport()

pushViewport(vplayout(2, 3))
venn_sal_case <- draw.pairwise.venn(
  area1 = 233, area2 = 281, cross.area = 33,
  category = c("Adult", "Larval CASE"),
  fill = c("grey90", larval_colors[3]),
  alpha = rep(0.5, 2),
  cex = 1.5, cat.cex = 1.3,
  fontfamily = "sans", cat.fontfamily = "sans", cat.fontface = "bold",
  cat.pos = c(0, -10),
  cat.dist = rep(0.025, 2),
  ext.text = FALSE,
  print.mode = "raw"
)
grid.draw(venn_sal_case)
popViewport()

# Single legend centered under all
pushViewport(viewport(x = 0.5, y = 0.03, width = 0.7, height = 0.08, just = "center"))
grid.text("Larval Treatment", y = 1, gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"))
legend_grob <- legendGrob(
  labels = larval_treatments,
  pch = rep(19, 3),
  gp = gpar(col = larval_colors),
  nrow = 1
)
grid.draw(legend_grob)
popViewport()

dev.off()
```
